Today we're excited to announce the launch of Lody — a new platform designed to help developers run AI coding agents anywhere, in parallel, and with their teams.

## The Problem

As AI coding assistants become more powerful, developers face new challenges:

- **Context Collisions** — Running multiple agents on the same codebase leads to conflicts and confusion.
- **No Visibility** — It's hard to track what changes agents are making in real-time.
- **Desktop Bound** — You can't review or approve changes from your phone.
- **Solo Experience** — Sharing agent context with teammates is cumbersome.

## Our Solution

Lody addresses these challenges with a simple but powerful approach:

### Worktree Isolation

Every task gets its own isolated git worktree. This means you can run multiple agents in parallel — each working on a different feature or bug fix — without any collisions.

```bash
npx lody start
```

That's all it takes to get started. Lody handles the worktree creation, agent orchestration, and sync automatically.

### Real-time Sync

See every edit as it happens. Each agent response includes an in-context diff, so you can review changes without switching back to your IDE. The file tree stays synced in real-time, giving you full visibility into what's happening.

### Mobile First

Lody ships native iOS and Android apps, built for mobile. Get push notifications when tasks complete, review diffs on your phone, and approve changes from anywhere. Vibe coding doesn't have to stop when you leave your desk.

### Team Workspaces

Share agents, skills, and conversation context with your team. Everyone stays on the same page, and knowledge compounds across the organization.

## What's Next

We're just getting started. Here's what's on our roadmap:

- **More Agent Support** — We're adding support for more AI coding agents beyond Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
- **Custom Skills** — Define reusable skills that agents can learn and apply.
- **CI/CD Integration** — Connect Lody to your existing workflows.
